name: [daemind] 09 - Régua de Reativação RFM de Clientes Inativos (Listmonk + WhatsApp)

parameters.query:
SELECT c.id AS cliente_id, c.nome, c.email, c.whatsapp, MAX(p.data_criacao) AS ultima_compra, COUNT(p.id) AS total_compras, SUM(p.valor_total) AS ltv_total
FROM clientes c
JOIN pedidos p ON p.cliente_id = c.id
WHERE p.status_operacional = 'Pago'
GROUP BY c.id, c.nome, c.email, c.whatsapp
HAVING MAX(p.data_criacao) <= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days')
   AND COUNT(p.id) >= 1
   AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM fila_mensageria f 
     WHERE f.aggregate_id = c.id 
       AND f.event_type = 'reativacao_rfm' 
       AND f.created_at >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')
   )
ORDER BY ltv_total DESC
LIMIT 20;

INSERT INTO fila_mensageria (event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, whatsapp, payload, status, idempotency_key)
VALUES (
  'reativacao_rfm',
  'clientes',
  {{$('Consultar Clientes Inativos RFM (PostgreSQL)').item.json.cliente_id}},
  '{{$('Consultar Clientes Inativos RFM (PostgreSQL)').item.json.whatsapp}}',
  '{"tipo": "cupom_volta15", "ltv": {{$('Consultar Clientes Inativos RFM (PostgreSQL)').item.json.ltv_total}}}'::jsonb,
  'concluido',
  'reativacao_{{$('Consultar Clientes Inativos RFM (PostgreSQL)').item.json.cliente_id}}_' || TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMM')
)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
